what: the paint scores recomputed with the AS7341's measured response (DS000504 v3-00 Fig. 19) instead of Gaussian passbands, under even light and under a CIE white LED

response_curves.source: DS000504 v3-00 Figure 19, diffuser on package, F1-F8 at 256x, relative to F8's peak; extracted by extract_as7341_response.py

assumptions.gain: Fig. 19 is at 256x, the readings at 128x; relative channel sensitivities taken as gain-independent
assumptions.pigments_outside_380_730: held at the end values; alternatives beyond 730 nm in nir_extrapolation
assumptions.leds: CIE 015:2018 LED-B1..B5 from colour-science SDS_ILLUMINANTS, 380-780 nm, 0 outside
assumptions.units: E and Fig. 19 both taken as per unit energy, so no wavelength weighting

illuminant_fit.what: white H12 counts minus the board lamp offset against sum E r_k R_TiO2, one overall scale fitted in log at 440-670 nm; residual = measured / predicted - 1, %, all 8 channels (410 predicted, not fitted)

gaussian.what: Gaussian at the typical centre and FWHM, even light, 380-730 nm (analyse_paint_accuracy.per_channel)

led_tail.what: LED continued past 780 nm, exponential fall 47 nm

unexplained_f1_light.what: the white well's 410 nm reads 62% above LED-B4 x Fig. 19 (scale fitted at 440-670 nm); that light added to F1 inside 390-440 nm only, or outside it only
